worldRules: 31 cells; start at 15, charge 60, heat 0. Seeded patch locations 4..26 change after 120..180 ticks.
Private light is 20 + max(0, 100−4×distance). Each phase has a 6-tick cloud at its seeded local 34..44 start, reducing the directional field to 3/4.
The source is dark during local ticks 92..99. This publishes known absence; photosynthesis stops and heat cools. Light-instrument downtime at ticks modulo 211 in 51..53 leaves presence unavailable.
Visible integer charge receives +9/+6/+3 at patch distances 0/1/2, or −1 elsewhere. Clouds divide positive intake by 3. Actual movement costs 1 charge.
Heat rises 5 within 2 cells of an active patch, or 2 during clouds; otherwise it cools 4. Heat 90 or greater costs 3 additional charge.
The runner supplies query fees. Their fractional remainder persists; completed charge units are debited after observations with the chosen action.
A cycle first reaches charge 80, then heat ≤20 at least 3 cells from the patch with charge ≥20. Cycles, starvation (charge ≤5), and overheating (heat ≥90) are external outcomes only.
Opaque light services expose presence/order only. Physiological services publish into the receiver-provided partition/capacity, without a wider numeric rescue or a write to controller memory.
metadata.sourceBoundary: Light offers opaque acquisitions, known presence or absence, and requested pair order. Unavailable acquisition is open. No light magnitude, patch location, position or outcome is written to brain memory. Body sensors have separately declared local energy and heat units. All rules, orientation, amount laws and persistent memory are native Gojo relations/carriers; JSON is a read-only projection.
metadata.observationCadence: Presence each tick; comparison-memory acquisition every two ticks. One-tick reuse of the last bank read is explicit in the loop. Unavailable acquisitions preserve the banks and expose open current evidence. Leaks count admitted acquisition steps, not wall-clock time.
metadata.costs: Each actual reference comparison costs0.002 energy; a requested eye ordering costs1; a selected finer body read costs0.25. Fractions accrue in the external world ledger. These are declared experimental costs, not measured CPU pricing or paid model calls.
metadata.amountContract: Separate local domains: energy/heat capacities−100..100. Four time ticks correspond to a declared conservative drain16 and heat rise20. Coarse energy subtraction uses a native table. Finer amount arithmetic preserves clipping/open support. Light order is never subtracted as a distance.
metadata.limitations: Authored controller, no learning or breeding. Baseline reference comparisons are eager, not a free lookup or lazy observer. Active memory is bounded; replay contains projections and each run retains only its final native archive. Diagnostic conditions demonstrate local boundary utility; aggregate outcomes may favor removals.

episodes.title: First acquisition
episodes.description: Presence is available; comparison memory is still uncalibrated and open.

episodes.title: First use: fast
episodes.description: Recent relative rise: continue without finer sensing

episodes.title: First use: slow
episodes.description: Brief decline: budget permits a four-tick wait

episodes.title: First use: reserve
episodes.description: Brief decline: budget permits a four-tick wait

episodes.title: First use: forecast
episodes.description: Brief decline: budget permits a four-tick wait

episodes.title: First use: precision
episodes.description: Cooled with a healthy reserve: rest

episodes.title: Unavailable is not dark
episodes.description: The current acquisition stays open; it does not become a zero-light landmark.

episodes.title: A short cloud
episodes.description: Short and longer comparison context may disagree. This does not guarantee that waiting is useful.

diagnostics.title: Warmup is not a zero score
diagnostics.description: The first present acquisition has no reference score. A second equal acquisition produces a native zero score with all comparison signs equal. The private fixture value is zero in both cases; that value is never published as a brightness coordinate.
diagnostics.full: presence 1, fast open, slow open; action 1 (right), mode 0, wait 0; Seek the brighter right eye; fine queries 0, spatial queries 1; reserve/heat forecast open/open
diagnostics.without: presence 1, fast 0, slow 0; action 1 (right), mode 0, wait 0; Seek the brighter right eye; fine queries 0, spatial queries 1; reserve/heat forecast open/open

diagnostics.title: Missing, absent, and present zero stay distinct
diagnostics.description: An unavailable acquisition exposes open presence; a dark source exposes presence 0; a present zero-valued private fixture exposes presence 1 and comparable equal events. The full controller holds for the first two with different native reasons. Removing the presence routes makes both continue.
diagnostics.full: Missing: action 0 (hold), mode 0, wait 0; Unresolved acquisition: hold while preserving uncertainty; fine queries 0, spatial queries 0; reserve/heat forecast open/open; absent: action 0 (hold), mode 0, wait 0; Measured absence: conserve movement for now; fine queries 0, spatial queries 0; reserve/heat forecast open/open; present private zero: action 1 (right), mode 0, wait 0; Seek the brighter right eye; fine queries 0, spatial queries 1; reserve/heat forecast open/open
diagnostics.without: Missing: action 1 (right), mode 0, wait 0; Presence handling removed: continue on open evidence; fine queries 0, spatial queries 0; reserve/heat forecast open/open; absent: action 1 (right), mode 0, wait 0; Presence handling removed: continue on open evidence; fine queries 0, spatial queries 0; reserve/heat forecast open/open

diagnostics.title: Reversed eye wiring needs its installed orientation
diagnostics.description: The physical right eye is brighter. Mirrored wiring returns sensor order −1 over its actual swapped acquisition pair. The exposed inverse frame calibration maps that ordinal sign to body-right; removing it makes the same native controller choose body-left.
diagnostics.full: action 1 (right), mode 0, wait 0; Seek the brighter right eye; fine queries 0, spatial queries 1; reserve/heat forecast open/open
diagnostics.without: action -1 (left), mode 0, wait 0; Seek the brighter left eye; fine queries 0, spatial queries 1; reserve/heat forecast open/open

diagnostics.title: A sufficient coarse support avoids extra precision
diagnostics.description: The exposed energy region 85..100 lies wholly above the feeding-to-cooling threshold, and heat 0..19 already establishes cooling. Finer energy and heat readings do not change this response, so the selective native query rules avoid both fees.
diagnostics.full: action 0 (hold), mode 1, wait 0; Cooled with a healthy reserve: rest; fine queries 0, spatial queries 0; reserve/heat forecast open/open
diagnostics.without: action 0 (hold), mode 1, wait 0; Cooled with a healthy reserve: rest; fine queries 2, spatial queries 0; reserve/heat forecast open/open

diagnostics.title: Precision is useful when the same support crosses a decision
diagnostics.description: Energy 79 and 80 initially publish the same 70..84 region. A paid finite body reading resolves the native threshold: seek the brighter right side at 79, leave it to cool at 80. Without that service both remain under the same conservative coarse response.
diagnostics.full: 79: action 1 (right), mode 0, wait 0; Seek the brighter right eye; fine queries 1, spatial queries 1; reserve/heat forecast open/open; 80: action -1 (left), mode 1, wait 0; Cooling: leave the brighter right side; fine queries 1, spatial queries 1; reserve/heat forecast open/open
diagnostics.without: 79: action 1 (right), mode 0, wait 0; Seek the brighter right eye; fine queries 0, spatial queries 1; reserve/heat forecast open/open; 80: action 1 (right), mode 0, wait 0; Seek the brighter right eye; fine queries 0, spatial queries 1; reserve/heat forecast open/open

diagnostics.title: Longer context can change a brief decline response
